purposeStatement: Horizontal mutually-exclusive group of 2-4 equal-width segments where exactly one is selected; use to switch between a small fixed set of peer views/options. NOT for page navigation, binary on/off (use Switch), or >4 options / free text (use Select).

antiPatterns.pattern: A row of raw <button>s with inline background/padding faking a selected tab
antiPatterns.reason: Re-invents an inline one-off with hardcoded styling that drifts from the token scale instead of reusing the registered control.

antiPatterns.pattern: Using a Switch or multiple checkboxes for a single-choice option group
antiPatterns.reason: A segmented control encodes single-select among peers; a Switch is binary and checkboxes imply multi-select.
